name: pi-deepseek-search-tools
description: DeepSeek Search & Fetch for Pi: deepseek_search for live web results via the official POST /v1/tools/search API and deepseek_fetch for full-page Markdown via POST /v1/tools/fetch. Requires a DeepSeek API key (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or /deepseek-setup).
